review_findings.detail: All23 current pilot maps inspected; initial20 independent inventory was completed before reading candidates. Added native/original packets resolved special-floor artwork reuse. Reviewed all25 final candidates, six Zulkheim plus19 north_east. Every acceptance requires its supplied corrections.

Accept means endpoints/topology are supported by inspected artwork and cited Horizon-compatible connection evidence. No live game was running, no coordinates were traversal-tested, and traversal_verified remains false. Corrected coordinates are map-annotation focus estimates, not measured game trigger coordinates.

Initial Zulkheim LaTheine2 -> ordelle3/floor14 was wrong because that native floor is the apparatus spur. Revised candidate retargets ordelle4/floor15, which original geometry corroborates. Eldieme floor14 and FeiYin floor14 likewise cannot inherit large replacement-overlay exits.

Initial Jugner-to-Landing candidates used NM-overlay positions as destination mouths and assumed pairings not established by artwork. They were removed before final hash. Preserve the two routes as unresolved, not rejected physical exits.
Initial latheine-west-ronfaure candidate duplicated an existing seed route and used suspicious endpoint locations. Worker removed it; deferred seed route remains outside this final candidate review.

Many candidate coordinates pointed to destination title text, leader arrowheads or blank map. Final decisions move physical endpoints to road/tunnel mouths and preserve distinct visible glyph coordinates for printed codes.

Worker inventory is not fully corrected by passage corrections: Zulkheim LaTheine Map2 still hints ordelle3 instead of ordelle4; north_east Batallia7 inventory is at [185,290] instead of actual [184,177]; many boundary inventory rows remain on arrows. Apply reviewed endpoint corrections to any displayed inventory or keep inventory audit-only.

Acceptances preserve Monastic north/central/east, Eldieme3 main/northwest/west/southwest, Batallia main/northwest/island and Landing2 north_landing components. Do not collapse components merely because map keys match.

Worker unresolved entries retain Gustav, Lufaise, Pashhow, Gusgen, Gustaberg, ferry, Jeuno, Rolanberry, Xarcabard, PsoXja six entries, QuBia and Cloister. Outside-pilot status is not evidence that an exit is invalid.
